name: CobSwap
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Hawkingbert
description: Client-side Fabric mod that places cobwebs for you in combat: left-click a block near an enemy with a sword or axe, and it swaps to your cobweb, places it, and swaps back. Adjustable delay and toggle key. No server install needed.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-27 (90fcc9da) (41 classes, 56 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
